title: Testing with Coding Agents: A Large-Scale Comparison of Agent-Supported and Human-Authored Pull Requests
abstract: arXiv:2610.35297v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context. Coding agents increasingly contribute tests through pull requests that developers then maintain, so how testing work is divided affects long-term maintainability.   Objective. We compare pull requests in which developers and coding agents collaborate (agent-supported) with pull requests without detectable agent involvement (human-authored) along five dimensions: the frequency and extent of test changes, their type and context, test structure, test smells, and code coverage.   Method. We analyze 114,134 pull requests merged between January 2025 and April 2026 in 391 Java repositories, identifying five coding agents through pull-request-level and commit-level signals. Since agent adoption varies across projects, we compare the two groups within repositories with mixed-effects models that control for change size.   Results. translated_title: 使用编码智能体进行测试：智能体支持的与人工编写的拉取请求的大规模比较
translated_abstract: 背景：编码智能体越来越多地通过拉取请求贡献测试代码，而这些代码随后由开发者维护，因此测试工作的分工方式会影响软件的长期可维护性。目标：我们从五个维度比较开发者与编码智能体协作的拉取请求（智能体支持型）与无可检测智能体参与的拉取请求（人工编写型）：测试变更的频率与范围、变更的类型与上下文、测试结构、测试坏味道以及代码覆盖率。方法：我们分析了391个Java仓库中2025年1月至2026年4月间合并的114,134个拉取请求，并通过拉取请求级别和提交级别的信号识别出五种编码智能体。由于智能体的采用率在不同项目之间存在差异，我们在仓库内部采用控制了变更规模的混合效应模型对两组进行比较。结果：跨仓库汇总来看，两组变更测试代码的频率几乎相同；在仓库内部，其几率（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究通过对391个Java仓库中114,134个拉取请求的大规模实证分析，首次系统比较了编码智能体支持的与人工编写的测试变更在频率、范围、类型、结构、坏味道和覆盖率五个维度上的差异，为理解智能体时代测试工作的分工及其对长期可维护性的影响提供了重要依据。
en_tdlr: This study presents the first large-scale empirical comparison of agent-supported versus human-authored test changes, analyzing 114,134 pull requests across 391 Java repositories along five dimensions to understand how coding agents divide testing work with developers and its impact on long-term maintainability.
